Admissions
You are here: Home / Prospective Students / Admissions
The Berkeley – UCSF Graduate Program in Bioengineering welcomes applications for the PhD in bioengineering from outstanding, highly motivated students with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in related fields.
Graduate applications are due December 1
Applications are accepted for fall entry only and admitted applicants are expected to join the program on schedule, the fall semester of their admission year – e.g. fall 2027 for students who apply in fall 2026. Please plan your application accordingly. Learn more about the application for admission.
Apply now
Eligibility
We invite applications from students with a strong interest in the life sciences and demonstrated strength in mathematics and physical sciences. Consideration is also given to applicants with strong, relevant life science backgrounds who have demonstrated quantitative skills. Our program attracts motivated, independent students with a breadth of experience who are eager to contribute to the growing field of bioengineering.
We are particularly interested in providing educational opportunities for students with unique perspectives and experiences.
Anyone with a Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree in engineering, biology, or other sciences, is eligible for admission. Appropriate academic preparation includes a two-year college mathematics sequence, including calculus and differential equations, and a one-year sequence in physics and chemistry, plus extensive upper-division work in either engineering or biology. A course in linear algebra is highly desirable. Outstanding students lacking some of these requirements may be admitted on the condition that they complete the basic entrance requirements immediately after admission.
In addition to the above undergraduate work, a successful applicant generally has a minimum grade point average of 3.5 or higher (on a 4.0 scale), and three strong letters of recommendation from faculty with whom they have worked closely. Most of our successful applicants also have some prior research experience.
Evaluation Process
Recommendation for admission is based on a comprehensive evaluation by a committee of faculty and senior graduate students. The Admissions Committee considers many factors, including applicants’ academic record, research experience, scholarly activities, letters of recommendation, and the statement of purpose and personal history statement. We also seek a balance between the applicant’s research interests and available faculty resources.
Timeline
Applications Open
The online application for admission opens in mid-September.
Application Due
All application materials must be received no later than December 1, 8:59 PM PST.
Application Review
The admissions committee will review applications throughout December and January.
Invitation to Visit
All applicants will be notified of their status by the end of January. Those selected to interview will be invited to visit campus.
Campus Visits
Interviews and visits will be held Wed–Fri, February 17-19, and February 24-26, 2027.
Admission
Successful applicants will be offered admission in March.
Offer Acceptance
Admitted students will have until April 15 to accept or decline their offer of admission.
